item.title: 100 days of inference
item.description:
The Problem
Serving LLMs in production spans a wide stack—CUDA kernels, quantization, serving engines, autoscaling, and multi-cloud capacity. Most engineers learn these topics in isolation, with no structured path from "how a transformer generates text" to "how to deploy across clouds without downtime." The repo addresses that gap with a day-by-day curriculum that pairs each concept with a runnable notebook.

item.title: job application agent
item.description:
The Problem
Job seekers using AI coding assistants face a credibility gap: agents can generate applications but cannot verify credentials, detect duplicates, or maintain a private application ledger. The result is spammy, unverifiable submissions that reflect poorly on the candidate and waste hiring teams' time.
